notes:
New
• Solo vids: choose which audio track is Discord. In the project, under "Who's in it: Solo vid", a new "Discord track" setting lets you pick Track 2, Track 3, both, or no Discord track. Solis cuts exact

Fixed
• Premiere no longer freezes and closes ("Not Responding") during long edits. Solis builds the edit with the sequence closed and opens it when the edit is done, so Premiere doesn't redraw the whole time
• If Premiere starts to slow down, Solis gives it up to 20 seconds to catch up before sending anything else. Sounds, music and images are imported at the start, one file at a time.
• No saving in the middle of an edit: the project is saved once at the end. A busy Premiere is waited for instead of "Edit stopped"; Resume Edit continues an edit that was interrupted.
